text:
- United Kingdom generated £118.1k revenue TW, representing 78.3% of total sales across all countries.
- Total revenue across all countries declined to £150.8k TW from £172.9k LW, a WoW decrease of 12.7%.
- United Kingdom revenue fell 15.6% WoW, declining from the previous week despite maintaining the largest market share.
- EIRE delivered £23.9k revenue TW with exceptional growth of 1040.5% WoW, the strongest performance among all markets.
- Germany contributed £3.9k revenue TW with a modest WoW decline of 6.8%, while France also experienced a 6.8% WoW decrease.
- Total units sold reached 75,004 TW, with United Kingdom accounting for 58,751 units and EIRE for 10,183 units.
- United Kingdom processed 320 orders TW, significantly higher than EIRE and Germany which each recorded 8 orders.
- Total order volume across all countries was 346 orders TW, with United Kingdom representing 92.5% of all transactions.
